other.powersofarrest:
Under section 6D(2) a constable may arrest a person without warrant if -
(a) the person fails to co -operate with a preliminary test in pursuance of a requirement imposed under section 6, and
(b) the constable reasonably suspects that the person has alcohol or a drug in his body or is under the influence of a drug

N.B. the failure to co-operate is, in itself, insufficient grounds to arrest, the officer must also have a belief that the suspect has alcohol/drugs in his/her body or is under the influence of a drug.
other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement. Licence endorsed four points.

Disqualification discretionary.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
